COMPLETE. Implemented and ran the coupled Farquhar(C4, with C3 also coded)/Collatz + Ball-Berry model in analysis.py and produced all four required artifacts under results/.

CONFIRMED CONVENTIONS APPLIED (per your approvals):
- Rd=0.015*Vcmax_eff where Vcmax_eff=Vcmax(T)*n_factor*btran (A5: scaled).
- Night Ci via the full diffusion chain (A8), with A=-Rd and gs=b0.
- esat via CLM/Antoine form, noted in a code comment (A1).

COUPLED FIXED POINT (per leaf): iterate Ci_{k+1}=f(Ci_k) with update order Ci -> A/A_mol -> cs -> gs -> rs -> Ci_new; tol 1e-6 Pa, max_iter 200, damping 0.5 + bisection-style guard. 1-D because A depends only on Ci.

RESULTS EVIDENCE:
- leaf_fluxes.csv: 120 rows, exactly 9 columns [time_hr,A_sun,A_shade,rs_sun,rs_shade,ci_sun,ci_shade,gs_sun,gs_shade], 0 nulls, no NaN/inf. - diurnal.png: valid PNG 1000x700 (verified by re-decoding IDAT; decompressed byte length matches exactly). 2-panel layout: top=A (sun red / shade orange), bottom=rs (sun red / shade orange), shared x-axis time_hr, with frames, ticks, and legend.
